relationships.subject: hyaluronan
relationships.evidence_quote: It interacts with multiple membrane receptors, including TRPV1 and CD44 receptors, which are associated with inflammation and nociception.

relationships.subject: hyaluronidase
relationships.evidence_quote: HA degradation is carried by hyaluronidase (HYAL).

key_findings: Review: HA has size-dependent dual roles in nociception, and HA accumulation in muscle and fascia is linked to pain and stiffness.
Intramuscular hyaluronidase is proposed as a treatment needing controlled trials.
